title: SynthID Detector
summary: SynthID Detector is Google's tool for identifying AI-generated content by detecting invisible watermarks embedded by their SynthID technology. It provides a way to verify whether images or audio were created by AI models, helping address the growing challenge of content authenticity in the generative AI era.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of distinguishing AI-generated content from human-created content, addressing misinformation and authenticity verification challenges.
why_valuable: As AI-generated content becomes increasingly realistic, SynthID Detector provides essential infrastructure for trust and verification in digital media.
